summary: Bluejay Diagnostics filed an 8-K reporting a September 1, 2026 Distribution, Co-Marketing Strategic Partnership Agreement with Lovell Government Services, an SDVOSB federal healthcare distributor. Lovell gains non-exclusive open-market federal, state and local resale rights plus sole exclusive rights to distribute Bluejay products under SDVOSB set-aside procurements (VA, DoD, IHS) after FDA clearance. Pricing is fixed for twelve months; price increases need ninety days notice; Lovell remits within three business days of government payment or thirty days from invoice, with a roughly 15% distribution fee. This is a routine commercial distribution contract, not a special situation.
